title: CAT 2023 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Aptitude - Permutation and Combination
subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.q: The number of all natural numbers up to 1000 with non-repeating digits is
questions.explain:
We count the non-repeating numbers according to the number of digits. 
1-digit numbers (1 to 9): 9 choices.
2-digit numbers (10 to 99): First digit can be 1-9 (9 choices). Second digit can be 0-9 minus the first digit (9 choices). Total = $9 \times 9 = 81$.
3-digit numbers (100 to 999): First digit can be 1-9 (9 choices). Second digit can be 0-9 minus the first (9 choices). Third digit can be 0-9 minus the first two (8 choices). Total = $9 \times 9 \times 8 = 648$.
The only 4-digit number up to 1000 is 1000, which has repeating digits. 
The total is $9 + 81 + 648 = 738$.
